This is the original printed text (version 1 of 2). The current text is [[Daroe (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee Virtual Set 2 card sheet<ref name="eh1362-da-0">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-2.pdf Virtual Set 2 card sheet], Players Committee, page 1. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20151010191753/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-2.pdf Internet Archive], captured 10 October 2015.</ref>. Dated by 10 October 2015 (the earliest preserved copy of the Players Committee Set 2 card sheet); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Daroe (V) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} The PC card image with the same words is in the Holotable repository by 8 July 2018 (commit 022435b). Text: “[Pilot] 2. Information Broker. When deployed, may ▼ a droid here or a Restraining Bolt. During battle, may retarget an opponent's weapon targeting your droid to another one of your characters present (even Daroe).” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Daroe (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1362-da-1">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/daroe.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7deddc7ba5815bab0aff7ba0699002f6647d34 commit ab7dedd] (26 October 2022).</ref>. First published 26 October 2022. The PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). Text: “[Pilot] 2. Information broker. When deployed, may ▼ a droid here or a Restraining Bolt. During battle, may retarget an opponent's weapon targeting your droid to another one of your characters present (even Daroe).” '''What changed:''' game text: “Information Broker” → “Information broker”; the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. No errata mark. Before/after (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V2-D-daroe-2022-10-26-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] → [[File:V2-D-daroe-2022-10-26-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]]. This is change 1 in release order, so the missing mark is listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026: number versions by release order and record the printed mark). This is the current text.
